evidence_basis.critical_scope_note: The current native libero_spatial task0 positive-control evaluation is not interchangeable with custom LIBERO-36 task0. The following comparisons must use the same custom task data, environment, initialization states, evaluator, and protocol.

source_parity_audit.scope_note: This verifies source-to-frozen-dataset action/state fidelity. It does not prove historical V3 training used these exact converted bytes or establish all-frame image identity.

options_compared.reason: Without a task0-only model trained on task_index 0 from the same frozen dataset, a 4-task failure cannot distinguish multi-task interference from a task/data/protocol mismatch.
This would give each task only about 2500 optimizer updates and confound task count with lower per-task training exposure.

First establish a same-source task0-only control on task_index 0 from the frozen 32-task dataset; only after that gate passes, train tasks 0-3 with equal sampling and four times the total updates so each task receives the same expected sample exposure.

selected_protocol.data: the same frozen 32-task LeRobot dataset at /root/smolvla-training-prep/datasets/lerobot/libero36_feasible_32_frozen_v1 for both runs; do not rebuild or alter it. A deterministic sampler selects task_index 0 for the single-task run and task_index 0-3 for the four-task run.
selected_protocol.common_initialization: the same verified base initialization for both runs; do not initialize the multi-task run from the task0-trained checkpoint
